SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cr.id AS id, 'report' AS sendType, '리포트' AS sendTypeName, cr.customer_id AS customerId, CASE WHEN cr.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.name WHEN cr.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN ic.name END AS customerName, cr.conversion_status_code AS customerStageCode, CASE cr.conversion_status_code WHEN '01' THEN '잠재 고객' WHEN '02' THEN '통합 고객' ELSE '-' END AS customerStageName, cr.report_type_code AS sendItemCode, CASE cr.report_type_code WHEN '01' THEN '생애주기 성장 리포트' WHEN '02' THEN '질병 통계 리포트' ELSE COALESCE(report_type_code.code_name, '리포트') END AS sendItemName, cr.send_status_code AS sendStatusCode, COALESCE( send_code.code_name, CASE cr.send_status_code WHEN '01' THEN '발송대기' WHEN '02' THEN '발송성공' WHEN '03' THEN '발송실패' ELSE '-' END ) AS sendStatusName, COALESCE(cr.sent_at, cr.created_at) AS sentAt FROM customer_report cr LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc ON cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.id = cr.customer_id LEFT JOIN integrated_customer ic ON cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.integrated_customer_id = cr.customer_id LEFT JOIN common_code send_code ON send_code.group_code = 'SEND_STATUS' AND send_code.code_value = cr.send_status_code LEFT JOIN common_code report_type_code ON report_type_code.group_code = 'REPORT_TYPE' AND report_type_code.code_value = cr.report_type_code WHERE ( cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} ) OR ( cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} )
UNION ALL
SELECT wi.id AS id, 'webform' AS sendType, '웹폼' AS sendTypeName, wi.customer_id AS customerId, CASE WHEN wi.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.name WHEN wi.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN ic.name END AS customerName, wi.conversion_status_code AS customerStageCode, CASE wi.conversion_status_code WHEN '01' THEN '잠재 고객' WHEN '02' THEN '통합 고객' ELSE '-' END AS customerStageName, NULL AS sendItemCode, '상담 웹폼' AS sendItemName, wi.webform_status_code AS sendStatusCode, COALESCE( webform_code.code_name, CASE wi.webform_status_code WHEN '01' THEN '발송대기' WHEN '02' THEN '발송성공' WHEN '03' THEN '발송실패' WHEN '04' THEN '회수완료' ELSE '-' END ) AS sendStatusName, wi.issued_at AS sentAt FROM webform_issuance wi LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc ON wi.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.id = wi.customer_id LEFT JOIN integrated_customer ic ON wi.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.integrated_customer_id = wi.customer_id LEFT JOIN common_code webform_code ON webform_code.group_code = 'WEBFORM_STATUS' AND webform_code.code_value = wi.webform_status_code WHERE wi.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} ) history WHERE 1 = 1
AND history.sendType = #{request.sendType}
AND history.sendType = 'report' AND history.sendItemCode = '01'
AND history.sendType = 'report' AND history.sendItemCode = '02'
AND history.sendType = 'webform'
AND history.sendStatusCode = '01'
AND history.sendStatusCode = '02'
AND history.sendStatusCode = '03'
AND history.sendType = 'webform' AND history.sendStatusCode = '04'
AND ( LOWER(history.customerName) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{request.keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(history.customerStageName) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{request.keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(history.sendItemName) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{request.keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(history.sendStatusName) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{request.keyword}), '%') )
